scope: All canonical development KPI fields and player-quality measures; art pillars and production-cost dimensions are separate acceptance inputs

skills/development-observability/referen: KPI
Definition and limitation
Episode duration
UTC finish minus start. Includes waits; not thinking time or active human work. Interrupted/open episodes stay explicit.
Step duration
Monotonic elapsed time of an actually executed command. Summed parallel steps can exceed episode wall time.
Phase cost
Sum measured command seconds and imported token deltas assigned to that phase. Missing coverage is explicit.
Tokens
Input/output per completed Codex exec turn, with cached input a subset of input. Unknown is null, never zero.
Coverage
Imported turn count and episodes with counters. Total episode token coverage stays unknown without a complete harness census.
Rework
FAILURE_DEMAND seconds / classified command seconds; show classification coverage over all measured commands. UNKNOWN is excluded from the denominator. Not a ratio of all development time.
First pass
First decisive SATISFIED / contracts+revisions with a decisive SATISFIED or REJECTED review. PENDING/NOT_RUN are not failures. Continuations keep the same contract identity.
Acceptance/rules
Counts of canonical declared criteria/verdicts at recorded revisions. This is neither visual scoring nor a percentage of every rule in the plugin.
Problems

Open count, occurrence age/duration since recording (not the true age of a preexisting defect), recurrence by fingerprint, introduced/preexisting/unknown origin counts. These are declared incidents, not a count of all stderr lines.
Solutions
Declared VERIFIED / attempted solutions (TRIED, VERIFIED, REJECTED); planned fixes are excluded. Hash freshness is shown separately from historical success.
Trends
Recent episodes plus explicit comparable cohorts; median, sample count, P90 only at n>=10. No causal gain or statistical significance inferred.
Question
Measure
Interpretation boundary
Can a first-time player begin meaningfully?
Unassisted relevant actions / first attempts started; show x/n, failures, withdrawals and missing observations.
Success can be accidental. Separate help from in-game accessible controls.
Is accidental friction reduced?
Defined start-to-action durations; show individual values or distribution, sample n and attempts with no result by observation end.
Never hide unsuccessful attempts behind a median of successes. Faster is not always better.
Was a rule reused?
Transfer successes / observed transfer attempts, with new context and help received.
A scripted bot already knows the rule; a returning participant is not a fresh novice.
Can play resume?
Recoveries / observed attempts for the named interruption/error condition.
Do not pool menu return, load and death as interchangeable conditions.
Does assistance support autonomy?
Help level, request/intervention timing, recovery; preserve player comments separately.
Dwell or detour alone cannot diagnose confusion. Help use is not failure.
Does the interface work?
Blocking input/focus/return errors per executed task, device and build.
A static image or declaration cannot establish runtime behavior.
What did the change teach development?
Problem-to-decision delay, open issue age, cycles without criterion progress or material uncertainty reduction.
A useful rejected hypothesis is progress; fast wrong decisions are not.

pillars.requirement: Drawn primary/secondary forms, recognizable silhouettes and coherent proportions across asset families.
Controlled mid-poly workflow with recorded projected-size budgets and measured imported geometry, materials, textures and LOD behavior.
Broad readable local-color masses and restrained illustrated surface detail; photo sources must be adapted.
Editable black or near-black interior strokes tied to anatomy, folds, seams, grain, assembly, veins or wear; a contour shader alone cannot satisfy this.
Shared black or tinted near-black contour hierarchy, calibrated by projected size, distance and asset role using the unified theme.
Three dominant stylized diffuse value groups with controlled transitions and subordinate fill; preserve the unified theme under actual scene lighting.
One common form, color, ink and lighting grammar across characters, props, vehicles, buildings and vegetation, without per-game style assignments.
Preserve expressions, interactables, navigation, hazards, clue symbols and accessible information at the actual gameplay scale.

tokens.reason: No attributable codex exec per-turn trace; aggregate goal counters are not imported
